title: EEVblog #822 - World's Worst Tablet Computer Teardown
summary: Dave Jones of EEVblog tears down an Esinomed Infoview medical tablet computer built around an 800MHz AMD Geode board, exposing extremely shoddy construction and design.
why: HN calls it a famous, hilarious teardown and a go-to example of terrible hardware quality.

quote.text: If you are going to watch one teardown today then please watch his rather famous video about the worlds worst tablet computer
